$comment: High and critical npm advisories accepted for a stated reason until a stated date. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails the build on any high or critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its expiry. The six Expo SDK 52 build-tooling advisories listed here before were cleared by the Expo SDK 58 upgrade (docs/PLAN.md Phase 2.1). The three below are one advisory, GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw (published 19 November 2026): a ReDoS in effect's Schema.TemplateLiteral, fixed in effect 3.22.1. Prisma 7.10.1, the latest, pins effect at exactly 3.20.0 through @prisma/config. Checked 22 November 2026: none of the three is in the API's standalone build (apps/api/.next/standalone), which is what the Cloud Run image ships; @prisma/config is loaded only by the prisma command-line tool, on this repository's own prisma.config.ts, so no outside input reaches the regex. An npm override to effect 3.22.x was tried and refused: npm removed effect from the tree rather than re-resolving it, and forcing a version Prisma has not been tested with into the migration tool is a worse trade than this exception.

exceptions.reason: GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw, ReDoS in Schema.TemplateLiteral. Pinned at 3.20.0 by @prisma/config; used by the prisma CLI to load prisma.config.ts, our own file. Not in the API image.
exceptions.fix: a prisma release whose @prisma/config takes effect >= 3.22.1

exceptions.reason: Flagged only through effect (GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw). Loaded by the prisma CLI at generate and migrate time. Not in the API image.
exceptions.fix: a prisma release whose @prisma/config takes effect >= 3.22.1

exceptions.reason: The Prisma CLI, flagged only through @prisma/config and effect (GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw). A devDependency of @ride/db that npm audit counts as runtime because @prisma/client names it as a peer. Not in the API image.
exceptions.fix: a prisma release whose @prisma/config takes effect >= 3.22.1
